rationale: The v3 base faithfully promotes the researched v2 structure into development. The v4 redesign addresses the working evaluation's joint margin-and-rights limiter by narrowing to one equipment-class hypothesis and one dense pilot area, replacing inventory, consignment, and first-refusal dependence with a pre-quoted paid workflow event, and gating any brokerage route on pre-removal buyer and authorized-operator quotes. It asserts no signed right, partner commitment, price, paid conversion, margin, or repeat demand; those remain explicit validation gates.
